name: bank
line: Bank CSV and OFX statements as dated lines, with spending by month.

name: bookmarks
line: Browser bookmarks (HTML export, Firefox JSON) and history, read from a copy of its SQLite file.

name: browse
line: A local web page to ask questions and approve answers, reachable from this machine only.

name: care
line: For caregivers: medications, vitals and appointments from a care log, what's due and what moved.

name: changed
line: What's new, edited or deleted in your folder since the last check, as fingerprint rows.

name: claude
line: Suggestions from Claude through the Anthropic API, citing your passages.

name: dice
line: Seeded dice rolls as rows: every roll replayable and checkable.

name: dice5e
line: Full tabletop dice notation (4d6kh3, advantage).

name: digest
line: One page: suggestions waiting, approvals gone stale, dates coming up, questions repeated.

name: encrypt
line: Keeps the record folder encrypted at rest.

name: flashcards
line: Approved question-and-answer pairs become cards, scheduled by spaced repetition.

name: forecasts
line: Write a prediction before the outcome, settle it later, see your Brier score.

name: git-history
line: Commit messages and diffs as a dated pile: "when did we change the retry limit?"
needs: the git program; GPL, called not linked

name: health
line: Apple Health and Google Fit exports as daily numbers the readings add-on can trend.

name: invoices
line: For freelancers: invoices and payments matched by the id pattern you give, never guessed.

name: life
line: Conway's Game of Life as rows: a fully deterministic world on the record.

name: local-model
line: Suggestions from a model on this machine only, such as Ollama or llama.cpp.
needs: a local model server; licence varies by model

name: meaning
line: Search by meaning: "who owes me money" finds "invoice outstanding".
network: the model, downloaded once from Hugging Face

name: ocr
line: Text out of photos of letters and scanned PDFs.
needs: pytesseract and the tesseract program; Apache-2.0

name: pgp
line: Signs exports and reports with your PGP key, verifiable anywhere.
needs: the gpg program and python-gnupg; BSD

name: photos
line: When and where each photo was taken, as dated lines.

name: report
line: A self-checking bundle: the record, the approved answers, and a script that re-verifies them on any machine.

name: secrets-audit
line: Finds keys and passwords sitting in plain files.

name: sheets
line: Spreadsheets with formulas and formatting kept, beyond what the office add-on reads.

name: speak
line: Reads answers aloud.

name: stems
line: Word forms for 20+ languages, so "maisons" finds "maison".

name: synonyms
line: Suggests words-list lines for a word no file has.

name: typos
line: Forgives misspellings in questions.

name: voice
line: Dictation, calls and lectures transcribed into dated text.

name: words-de
line: German common words, so questions aren't matched on "der" and "und".

name: words-es
line: Spanish common words ("el", "y").

name: words-fr
line: French common words ("le", "et").

name: words-pt
line: Portuguese common words ("o", "e").
